html:
A Nigerian writer and television producer who led the Movement for the Survival of the Ogoni People against the pollution of their land in the Niger Delta by oil companies, chiefly Shell, and against the military government.

He wrote the novel Sozaboy (1985) in rotten English, about a boy soldier in the civil war. His campaign drew huge crowds in Ogoniland from 1990. The regime of Sani Abacha arrested him, and after a trial widely condemned as unfair he and eight others were hanged on 10 November 1995. Nigeria was suspended from the Commonwealth. See also Nigeria's oil.
